notes: Asking for a fraction of something now changes that thing, not the length of your video. “Make it a quarter of the volume” used to cut the clip down to a quarter of its running time and say so as though you had asked for it — and the same happened for speed, brightness, size and every other word in that position. Only a fraction of the clip, the video, its length or its duration shortens anything now. Anything else is handled by the part of Crisp that owns it, or asked about, rather than guessed at with a cut you cannot undo.
